title: Campaign Marketing Executive
company: Lloyd Recruitment Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Campaign Marketing Executive

Salary: £33,000 - £35,000 DOE

1 day in office and rest WFH

Outskirts of Crawley

Monday - Friday (35 hour week)

12 month FTC

Lloyd Recruitment Services are pleased to be working with a large, award winning B2 C organisation who are looking for a Campaign Marketing Executive to join their team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

This is a great opportunity for a campaign-focused marketer with hands-on email campaign management experience who enjoys coordinating activity, working with agencies and delivering engaging customer communications.

About the role

You'll be responsible for supporting and delivering targeted marketing campaigns across a range of customer communication channels, with a particular focus on email and CRM activity.

The role will involve:
- Managing and coordinating email marketing campaigns from brief through to delivery
- Working with internal teams to develop effective campaign plans and communications
- Briefing and liaising with external marketing agencies
- Creating and coordinating engaging marketing content and copy
- Supporting audience segmentation and targeted customer communications
- Monitoring campaign performance and using results to improve future activity
- Managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
- Ensuring communications are accurate, on-brand and delivered to a high standard

You'll ideally have:
- Experience managing email marketing campaigns from start to finish
- Previous experience briefing and working with external agencies
- B2 C marketing experience
- Strong copywriting and communication skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines
- A commercial and data-driven approach to campaign performance
- Confidence working with internal stakeholders and external suppliers
- Experience within the travel, leisure, membership or consumer sectors would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

Essential:
- Proven hands-on end to end campaign marketing experience, rather than a generalist Marketing Executive.

Salary: £33,000-£35,000 Contract: 12-month FTC

Extra Information
- Refer a friend and earn a retail voucher worth up to £500!
- Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
- By applying for this vacancy, you accept Lloyd Recruitment Services' Privacy and GDPR Policy.

Lloyd Recruitment Services are acting as a recruitment agency in relation to this vacancy and are an equal opportunities employer.

title: Digital Warehouse Assistant
description:
Confident at the trade counter and ready for your next step? Join Grove Group in Burgess Hill, where you'll keep online orders moving, help customers and develop your skills in a varied warehouse and e-commerce role.

Digital Warehouse Assistant

Burgess Hill, West Sussex
- Full-time, permanent
- Competitive salary, dependant on experience
- Valid driving licence essential

Please Note: Applicants must be authorised to work in the UK

About Grove Group

Grove Group is one of the UK's leading suppliers to the vehicle repair and refinish industry. With over 100 years' experience, we have developed numerous strong industry-relevant partnerships, enabling us to offer innovative products, services and support across the country.

Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution to all body shops and distribution partners with efficient delivery of the best products at competitive prices. Our Burgess Hill team supports trade and online customers, combining efficient order fulfilment with friendly, knowledgeable service.

The Role

We're looking for a reliable, organised Digital Warehouse Assistant to support our busy warehouse and e-commerce operation, including eBay orders.

There's a large volume of stock to move, so you'll need to be comfortable with a daily routine of picking, packing and dispatching orders accurately and efficiently. Alongside warehouse duties, you'll help customers at the trade counter and handle telephone and online enquiries.

You'll also have the opportunity to develop your operational skills and take on additional responsibility, deputising for the Business Manager during their absence.

What You'll Do
- Process, pick, check, pack and dispatch online and customer orders accurately.
- Receive and check deliveries, put stock away and maintain accurate stock records and locations.
- Prepare consignments and dispatch paperwork, process returns and support stock counts.
- Support e-commerce and eBay activity, resolving or escalating stock and order issues.
- Assist trade counter customers and respond professionally to telephone and online enquiries.
- Support the wider branch team, deputise for the Business Manager and undertake occasional deliveries, collections or stock transfers.
- Keep the warehouse clean, organised and safe, reporting stock discrepancies, damage and hazards promptly.

What We're Looking For
- Previous trade counter experience and a helpful, customer-focused approach.
- Experience of busy warehouse operations, with confidence handling high volumes of picking, packing and dispatch.
- Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, including eBay, and confidence using computer systems.
- A professional telephone manner and clear verbal and written communication.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail when handling stock, orders and paperwork.
- A dependable, flexible approach and willingness to develop your skills and take on responsibility.
- A valid driving licence.

What You'll Get
- A varied role combining warehouse operations, customer service and e-commerce.
- Opportunities to broaden your knowledge of car paint and automotive refinishing products.
- Scope to develop your skills and gain experience deputising for the Business Manager.

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this position, click 'apply' today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

Other suitable skills and experiences include: Warehouse Assistant, Warehouse Operative, E-commerce Assistant, Trade Counter Assistant, Trade Counter Sales Assistant, Stores Assistant, Parts Advisor, Dispatch Assistant, Stock Control Assistant.

title: Marketing and Sales Executive
description:
The role

Working with colleagues across the business, you will help us reach new customers, strengthen relationships with existing clients and communicate the value of our products and services.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns
- Creating engaging email, website and social-media content
- Promoting courses, webinars, resources and membership services
- Identifying prospective customers and new business opportunities
- Contacting schools, colleges, trusts and other education organisations
- Following up enquiries and developing promising sales leads
- Speaking confidently with prospective and existing customers
- Helping to prepare proposals, presentations and promotional materials
- Maintaining accurate customer and sales information
- Monitoring campaign activity and reporting on results
- Supporting webinars, events and new product launches
- Contributing ideas for improving our marketing and increasing sales

An excellent first step into marketing and business development

Creative Education Limited is looking for an enthusiastic and commercially minded graduate or early-career professional to join our team as a Marketing and Sales Executive.

This is an unusually varied opportunity for someone who wants to gain meaningful experience rather than simply provide junior administrative support. You will contribute to genuine marketing campaigns, communicate with schools and education professionals, help generate new business and promote a substantial portfolio of online training, webinars, resources and membership services.

This is initially a twelve-month contract covering maternity leave. It would be particularly suitable for a recent graduate, someone with early marketing or sales experience, or a capable individual seeking an opportunity to develop a career in marketing and business development.

About Creative Education

Creative Education is an established education and training company supporting schools, colleges and education professionals across the UK.

We provide an extensive range of high-quality online courses, live webinars, resources, professional development programmes and organisational membership services. Our work helps education professionals develop their knowledge, improve practice and achieve better outcomes for children and young people.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a covering letter explaining:
- Why this opportunity interests you
- What you could bring to Creative Education
- Any relevant marketing, sales, communications or customer-service experience
- When you would be available to start

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing & Communications Executive
- Location: Burgess Hill, Head Office
- Job Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week
- Working Pattern: Office-based
- Salary: £32,000

We're currently supporting a client in their search for a Marketing & Communications Executive to join their growing team. Working closely with senior leadership, this position plays a key role in delivering marketing initiatives and supporting wider business growth.

The successful candidate will be involved in creating engaging content, managing digital marketing activities, and supporting commercial objectives through effective communication, creative campaigns, and brand-focused marketing efforts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their marketing career within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support the delivery of the marketing strategy, ensuring consistent branding and tone of voice across all communications.
- Manage and create content for social media channels, keeping the website content fresh and optimised for SEO.
- Develop written, visual, and video content for digital channels, newsletters, case studies, and customer communications.
- Create and adapt marketing and sales collateral using Adobe Creative Suite.
- Support exhibitions, events, and sales activities with relevant communications and marketing materials.
- Maintain marketing activity calendars and assist with updates to the eCommerce site.
- Keep CRM and marketing data accurate and up-to-date.
- Monitor marketing activity and performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the business to identify content and marketing opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum 18 months experience in a marketing or communications role.
- Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, CRM systems, CMS, and Google Analytics.
- Skilled in creating and editing video and visual content.
- Creative with a keen eye for design and visual communication.
- Strong writing skills and confident in communication.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
- Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
- Experienced in using AI tools to support research, content creation, idea generation, editing, productivity, and marketing effectiveness.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-related incentives.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic work environment with a focus on innovation and creativity.
- Participation in industry events and exhibitions.

If you are interested, please apply as soon as possible.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced marketer to take ownership of a well-established consumer brand, leading integrated campaigns across brand, digital, media and product launches. Working closely with senior stakeholders, you'll drive commercial growth, strengthen brand positioning, and shape marketing strategy within a growing business.

Client Details

A growing multi-brand business with a strong customer focus, operating across both retail and eCommerce channels. The company offers a collaborative, fast-paced environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and play a key role in driving future growth.

Description
- Develop and deliver brand-focused marketing plans that support commercial growth
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, content, email and offline channels
- Drive brand awareness, customer engagement and lead generation activities
- Manage product launches and go-to-market campaigns from planning through to execution
- Own brand messaging, positioning and creative consistency across all customer touchpoints
- Monitor campaign performance, analyse results and optimise activity to maximise ROI
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of spend
- Oversee website content and customer journey improvements to enhance performance
- Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to deliver campaigns
- Identify market trends, customer insights and new opportunities for growth
- Produce regular performance reports and recommendations for senior stakeholders
- Champion a test-and-learn approach to continuously improve marketing effectiveness

Profile
- Proven experience in brand and digital marketing
- Strong campaign planning and execution skills
- Commercially minded with budget and ROI experience
- Skilled in stakeholder and agency management
- Confident using data and insights to drive decisions
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Highly organised and able to manage multiple projects
- Experience within retail, ecommerce or consumer brands
- Knowledge of CMS platforms, SEO, GA4 and email marketing
- Familiarity with Shopify, Magento, WordPress or Umbraco preferred
- Proactive, creative and results-driven approach to marketing

Job Offer
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Hybrid working (minimum 3 days in the office)
- Flexitime and flexible working environment
- 31 days holiday including bank holidays
- Workplace pension scheme
- Life insurance cover
- Employee wellbeing programme
- Educational and professional development support
- Staff discounts
- Free on-site parking
- Casual dress and collaborative company culture
- Regular social events and team activities
- Opportunity to make a significant impact within a growing consumer brand business
- Broad exposure across brand, digital, ecommerce and product marketing initiatives
